name: tool-tailer
title: PAI tool tailer
description: Tails the PAI tool-activity JSONL (packages/server/src/tool-tailer.ts) and mirrors each tool firing onto the panel as a non-persisted tool_event frame via POST /api/chat/events.

fields.name: ts
fields.description: the firing's own timestamp; absent when the tailed line carries none

fields.name: tool
fields.description: tool name, "?" when the tailed line names none

fields.name: channel
fields.description: the enrolling agent's channel, or the literal "system" pseudo-tab for sessions that never enrolled
